holding.description: The holding is the root of your company tree. Enter its trading name.
holding.label: Trading name of the holding
holding.required: Enter the holding's trading name to continue.

approach.description: Choose how the group consolidates its companies' emissions.

sectorGroups.description: Sector groups label the companies of one sector under the holding. Add as many as you need, or none.
sectorGroups.none: No sector group yet. You can continue without one.

companies.description: Add the group's main companies under the holding or a sector group.
companies.hint: Before the first bulk upload, create every company that appears in your fuel-card and invoice files.
companies.none: No company yet. You can continue without one.
companies.sharePercentInvalid: The share percent must be a number from 0 to 100.
companies.naceInvalid: The NACE code is not in the expected form.

boundaries.description: Declare, for each company, which categories its inventory boundary covers in {year}.
boundaries.matrixNote: A category you declare that receives no data shows red on the coverage matrix.
boundaries.none: No company that holds records yet.
boundaries.confirmed: The boundary of this year is confirmed.

superAdmins.description: Invite the Super Admins who run your companies, each with their companies.
superAdmins.none: No Super Admin yet. You can continue without one.
superAdmins.invitedNotDelivered: The account for {email} was created, but the invitation email could not be sent yet.

centralReporter.description: Optionally, give a standard user a central reporter grant: one category list over several companies.
centralReporter.noUser: No user can take the grant yet: a central reporter is a standard user, and a Super Admin assigns standard users to their companies.
centralReporter.accountsDescription: Map a fuel card or delivery account to its company now, or later on the Fuel files page. Rows of a mapped account form that company's batches.

finish.description: Finish the setup to open the company tree and the rest of the tool.
finish.failed: The setup could not be finished. Try again.

gate.failed: Your account could not be loaded.
